title: Practice 10: до-: as far as, reaching

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Все это ___ (довести / доводить — to lead, to take, to accompany, to bring) меня до невыносимой тоски.
exercises.why: **довести́** — **доводи́ть** — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald. **довезти́** — **довози́ть** — to take (to), to carry (as far as, to), to bring (to, as far as). — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Неточка Незванова».
exercises.context: довести́** — **доводи́ть — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald.
